# RootSdk.DevKit

> Developer toolkit for building apps and bots on the Root Platform. Designed for AI-agent-driven development.

## Navigation

- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Full navigation — quick start, sample catalog, api-samples index, doc pointers, schema reference

## Templates

- [Bot Template](templates/bot/): Starting point for new bots (server-only)
- [App Template](templates/app/): Starting point for new apps (client + server + networking)

## Documentation

- [Documentation Index](docs/index.md): Full index of all developer documentation with descriptions
- [Bot Guides](docs/llms-bot-guides.txt): Concepts, tutorials, and how-tos (~61K tokens)
- [Bot API Reference](docs/llms-bot-api.txt): All endpoints, parameters, types, and errors (~141K tokens)
- [App Guides](docs/llms-app-guides.txt): Concepts, tutorials, and how-tos (~106K tokens)
- [App API Reference](docs/llms-app-api.txt): All endpoints, parameters, types, and errors (~163K tokens)
- [All Bot Docs](docs/llms-bot.txt): Combined bot guides + API reference (~202K tokens)
- [All App Docs](docs/llms-app.txt): Combined app guides + API reference (~270K tokens)
- [Everything](docs/llms-full.txt): All documentation (~470K tokens)

## Samples

- [Sample Apps](apps/): 6 complete, runnable app examples (hello-world, data-storage, protobuf-service, suggestion-box, themes, tic-tac-toe)
- [Sample Bots](bots/): 6 complete, runnable bot examples (hello-world, all-channel-broadcast, new-member-welcome, reset-channel-description, role-assignment, role-list)

## API Samples

- [API Samples](api-samples/): 30 standalone bots, one per SDK domain. Every method covered with working code.

## Schemas

- [Permissions Map](schemas/permissions-map.json): Maps every SDK method to its required manifest permission
- [Manifest Schemas](schemas/): JSON schemas for validating root-manifest.json
